title: Navigating the AI Research Tool Landscape: A Critical Reflection
author: Vidya Venkappa
excerpt: A comprehensive analysis of today's leading AI research assistants based on my hands-on testing. I evaluate how these tools handle complex research queries, compare their accuracy, source attribution, and reasoning capabilities, and provide practical guidance for choosing the right AI research companion for different academic and professional needs.
